blocks.text: Majhul nisbat — diqqat bajaruvchida emas, harakat ob'ektida

Majhul nisbat (passive) — **be + V3**. Shakllari qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 21–22-darslar), bu darsda asosiy savol — **qachon** va **nega** majhul nisbat tanlanadi. Faol gapda ega harakatni bajaradi: Workers **built** the bridge. Majhul gapda ega harakatni **o'zi qabul qiladi**: The bridge **was built** in 1965. O'zbekchada ham xuddi shunday hodisa bor — majhul nisbat: fe'lga `-il-` / `-in-` (unlidan keyin `-l-` / `-n-`) qo'shiladi: qur**il**di, yoz**il**di, ol**in**di, tozala**n**di.

Inglizchada majhul nisbatning alohida qo'shimchasi yo'q: zamon va shaxsni **be** ko'rsatadi, asosiy fe'l esa doim **V3** shaklida qoladi. Shuning uchun **be** ni tashlab ketish mumkin emas — busiz gap buziladi. O'zbekchada esa majhul ma'no ko'pincha faol fe'lning **3-shaxs ko'pligi** bilan ham beriladi: «Uni ishdan **bo'shatishdi**» — He **was dismissed**. Bu holatda ingliz tilida deyarli doim majhul nisbat ishlatiladi.

items: **Bajaruvchi noma'lum**: My car **was stolen** last night. (kim o'g'irlagani noma'lum)
**Bajaruvchi muhim emas** — natija muhim: The road **was repaired** in a week.
**Gapning mavzusi — narsa**: yangiliklar, ilmiy matnlar, yo'riqnomalar, rasmiy e'lonlar: Passengers **are asked** to keep their bags with them.

items.text: The museum **is closed** on Mondays for cleaning.
Three men **were arrested** after the robbery in the city centre.
items.translation: Shahar markazidagi talonchilikdan keyin uch kishi **qo'lga olindi**.

items.text: Milk **is boiled** first, and then rice **is added**.

blocks.text: by — bajaruvchi faqat yangi va muhim bo'lsa

Bajaruvchi **by** bilan qo'shiladi, lekin faqat u **yangi va muhim ma'lumot** bo'lsa. Ingliz gapida yangi ma'lumot odatda **gap oxiriga** qo'yiladi, shuning uchun «kim?» degan savolga javob by bilan oxirida keladi: This mosque **was designed by** a Turkish architect. Ma'nosiz bajaruvchi (by people, by someone, by them) yozilmaydi: «English is spoken by people in many countries» — ortiqcha, to'g'risi: English **is spoken** in many countries.

items.text: The film **was directed by** a young woman from Fergana.
Our office **was designed by** the same architect as the new airport.
items.translation: Ofisimizni yangi aeroportni loyihalagan me'morning o'zi **loyihalagan**.

items.text: Most decisions **are made by** the board, not by the director.
items.translation: Ko'p qarorlarni direktor emas, kengash **qabul qiladi**.

blocks.text: **by** — kim qildi, **with** — nima bilan qilindi (asbob): The window **was broken by** a boy. — Derazani bir bola sindirdi. The window **was broken with** a stone. — Deraza tosh bilan sindirildi.

Bu darsning asosiy shakllari — **is / are + V3** (Present Simple) va **was / were + V3** (Past Simple). Lekin majhul nisbat har qanday zamonda bor: faqat **be** o'sha zamonga o'tadi, V3 o'zgarmaydi. Davomli, perfekt va modal fe'lli shakllar keyingi darsda batafsil o'tiladi (→ 43-dars).
Inkor va so'roq: be harakatlanadi, V3 joyida

Inkorda **not** be dan keyin keladi: isn't / aren't / wasn't / weren't + V3. So'roqda **be** egadan oldinga chiqadi: **Was** the letter **sent**? Bu yerda do / did **ishlatilmaydi** — «When did it built?» xato, to'g'risi: When **was** it **built**? «Kim tomonidan?» degan savolda **by** gap oxirida qoladi: Who **was** it **written by**?

items.text: **Was** the parcel **delivered** to the right address?
Photos **aren't allowed** in this part of the palace.
items.translation: Saroyning bu qismida suratga olishga **ruxsat berilmaydi**.

items.text: Who **was** this song **written by**? It's beautiful.
items.translation: Bu qo'shiqni kim **yozgan**? Juda chiroyli ekan.

blocks.text: Faol yoki majhul: gap nima haqida?

Ikkala gap ham grammatik to'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin, tanlov **gapning mavzusiga** bog'liq. Agar suhbat binoning o'zi haqida bo'lsa — It **was built** in the nineteenth century. Agar suhbat quruvchilar haqida bo'lsa — They **built** it in the nineteenth century. Inglizlar gapni tanish narsa bilan boshlab, yangi ma'lumotni oxiriga qoldirishni yaxshi ko'radi, majhul nisbat aynan shunga yordam beradi.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «The museum built in 1900» → The museum **was built** in 1900 (be tushib qoladi — o'zbekchada alohida yordamchi fe'l yo'q); «The accident was happened» → The accident **happened** (happen, arrive, die, seem, appear kabi o'timsiz fe'llardan majhul nisbat yasalmaydi, xuddi «sodir bo'lmoq» dan bo'lmagani kabi); «My phone was stole» → was **stolen** (V2 emas, V3); «I born in Samarkand» → I **was born** (→ 44-dars); har bir majhul gapga «by them / by people» qo'shish — keraksiz.

Ikki savol bering: 1) «**Kim** qilgani muhimmi?» — muhim bo'lmasa, majhul nisbat. 2) «Gapda **be** bormi, fe'l **V3** dami?» — ikkalasi ham bo'lishi shart. O'zbekcha tarjimada «-il- / -in-» yoki «-ishdi» bo'lsa, inglizchada ko'pincha majhul nisbat kerak bo'ladi.

rows: is / are + V3 — odatiy jarayon, fakt
So'roq: be + ega + V3 (do / did yo'q)
It **was painted by** a local artist.

examples.title: **is / are** + V3: how things are done
examples.description: Present Simple majhul: odatiy jarayonlar, qoidalar va umumiy faktlar — kim qilishi emas, nima qilinishi muhim.

sentences.text: Our office **is cleaned** every evening after everyone has gone home.
sentences.translation: Ofisimiz har kuni kechqurun hamma ketgandan keyin **tozalanadi**.

sentences.text: In most Uzbek families, plov **is cooked** in a huge pot called a kazan.
sentences.translation: Ko'p o'zbek oilalarida palov qozon deb ataladigan katta idishda **damlanadi**.

sentences.text: Most of the cotton in the region **is grown** in the Fergana Valley and Khorezm.
sentences.translation: Mintaqadagi paxtaning ko'p qismi Farg'ona vodiysi va Xorazmda **yetishtiriladi**.

sentences.text: English **is taught** in every school in the country from the first year.
sentences.translation: Ingliz tili mamlakatdagi har bir maktabda birinchi sinfdan **o'qitiladi**.

sentences.text: How **is** this cheese **made**? It tastes completely different from ours.
sentences.translation: Bu pishloq qanday **tayyorlanadi**? Ta'mi biznikidan butunlay boshqacha.

sentences.text: Passengers' bags **are checked** twice before they board the plane.
sentences.translation: Yo'lovchilarning sumkalari samolyotga chiqishdan oldin ikki marta **tekshiriladi**.

sentences.text: Every spring thousands of trees **are planted** along the roads around Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Har bahorda Samarqand atrofidagi yo'llar bo'ylab minglab daraxt **ekiladi**.

sentences.text: Salaries at our company **are paid** on the last Friday of each month.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyamizda maosh har oyning oxirgi juma kuni **to'lanadi**.

sentences.text: Lots of the vegetables sold in London **are imported** from Spain and Morocco.
sentences.translation: Londonda sotiladigan sabzavotlarning ko'pi Ispaniya va Marokashdan **keltiriladi**.

sentences.text: When a mistake **is found** in a report, the whole document **is sent** back to its author.
sentences.translation: Hisobotda xato **topilsa**, butun hujjat muallifiga qaytarib **yuboriladi**.

examples.title: **was / were** + V3: events and history
examples.description: Past Simple majhul: o'tmishda bo'lgan voqealar, tarixiy faktlar, kechagi yangiliklar.

sentences.text: The three madrasas of the Registan **were built** in the fifteenth and seventeenth centuries.
sentences.translation: Registondagi uchta madrasa XV va XVII asrlarda **qurilgan**.

sentences.text: My bike **was stolen** outside the library while I was returning some books.
sentences.translation: Kutubxonaga kitob qaytarayotganimda velosipedim eshik oldidan **o'g'irlandi**.

sentences.text: All the flights to London **were cancelled** yesterday because of thick fog.
sentences.translation: Quyuq tuman sababli kecha Londonga barcha reyslar **bekor qilindi**.

sentences.text: Penicillin **was discovered** by accident in a London laboratory in 1928.
sentences.translation: Penitsillin 1928-yilda London laboratoriyasida tasodifan **kashf etilgan**.

sentences.text: Two people **were injured** when a bus hit a tree on the Fergana road.
sentences.translation: Farg'ona yo'lida avtobus daraxtga urilib, ikki kishi **jarohatlandi**.

sentences.text: Last night our street **was closed** for several hours after a water pipe burst.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun suv quvuri yorilgach, ko'chamiz bir necha soatga **yopildi**.

sentences.text: Kate **was told** about the changes only on the morning of the meeting.
sentences.translation: Keytga o'zgarishlar haqida faqat yig'ilish kuni ertalab **aytildi**.

sentences.text: These photos **were taken** in Khiva during our honeymoon five years ago.
sentences.translation: Bu suratlar besh yil oldin asal oyimizda Xivada **olingan**.

sentences.text: In 1966 much of the old part of Tashkent **was destroyed** by a powerful earthquake.
sentences.translation: 1966-yilda Toshkentning eski qismi kuchli zilziladan katta darajada **vayron bo'lgan**.

sentences.text: Once the old cinema **was knocked down**, a shopping centre **was built** in its place.
sentences.translation: Eski kinoteatr **buzib tashlangach**, uning o'rniga savdo markazi **qurildi**.

examples.title: No **by**: the doer is unknown or obvious
examples.description: Bajaruvchi noma'lum, ravshan yoki muhim emas — shuning uchun by ishlatilmaydi. O'zbekchada ham «kim tomonidan» deyilmaydi.

sentences.text: Fresh bread **is delivered** to the shop at six every morning.
sentences.translation: Do'konga har kuni ertalab soat oltida yangi non **olib kelinadi**.

sentences.text: The thief **was caught** two days later in a cheap hotel in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: O'g'ri ikki kundan keyin Buxorodagi arzon mehmonxonada **qo'lga olindi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **was fined** for driving too fast near a primary school.
sentences.translation: Jasur boshlang'ich maktab yonida tez haydagani uchun **jarimaga tortildi**.

sentences.text: Our flat **was broken into** while we were on holiday in Turkey.
sentences.translation: Biz Turkiyada dam olayotganimizda kvartiramizga **o'g'ri tushdi**.

sentences.text: Hundreds of new jobs **are created** in the IT sector every year.
sentences.translation: Har yili IT sohasida yuzlab yangi ish o'rinlari **yaratiladi**.

sentences.text: Oliver **was promoted** last month, and now he manages a team of twelve.
sentences.translation: Oliverning o'tgan oy **lavozimi ko'tarildi**, endi u o'n ikki kishilik jamoani boshqaradi.

sentences.text: Sorry, this room **is used** for staff meetings on Monday mornings.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu xona dushanba kuni ertalab xodimlar yig'ilishi uchun **ishlatiladi**.

sentences.text: A lot of rubbish **is left** on the beaches after hot summer weekends.
sentences.translation: Issiq yozgi dam olish kunlaridan keyin plyajlarda juda ko'p axlat **tashlab ketiladi**.

sentences.text: When the mistake **was noticed**, the money had already gone to the wrong account.
sentences.translation: Xato **sezilganda**, pul allaqachon boshqa hisobga o'tib ketgan edi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza's wallet **was found** on the bus and **returned** to her the same day.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning hamyoni avtobusda **topilib**, o'sha kuniyoq unga **qaytarildi**.

examples.title: **by** + the doer: new and important information
examples.description: Bajaruvchi yangi va muhim ma'lumot bo'lsa, gap oxirida by bilan keladi. O'zbekchada bunday gap ko'pincha faol nisbatda tabiiyroq eshitiladi.

sentences.text: The poem «Farhod and Shirin» **was written by** Alisher Navoi in the fifteenth century.
sentences.translation: «Farhod va Shirin» dostonini XV asrda Alisher Navoiy **yozgan**.

sentences.text: Our new office **was designed by** a young architect from Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Yangi ofisimizni Edinburglik yosh me'mor **loyihalagan**.

sentences.text: Most of the questions at the conference **were asked by** students, not professors.
sentences.translation: Konferensiyadagi savollarning ko'pini professorlar emas, talabalar **berdi**.

sentences.text: Madina **was bitten by** our neighbour's dog, so she needed an injection.
sentences.translation: Madinani qo'shnimizning iti **tishlab oldi**, shuning uchun unga ukol kerak bo'ldi.

sentences.text: This app **is used by** more than two million people around the world.
sentences.translation: Bu ilovadan butun dunyoda ikki milliondan ortiq odam **foydalanadi**.

sentences.text: The final decision **was made by** the director herself, so nobody argued.
sentences.translation: Yakuniy qarorni direktorning o'zi **qabul qildi**, shuning uchun hech kim bahslashmadi.

sentences.text: Surprisingly, the cup **was won by** a team from the smallest town in the league.
sentences.translation: Ajablanarlisi, kubokni ligadagi eng kichik shaharning jamoasi **yutib oldi**.

sentences.text: Who **was** this portrait **painted by**? — By a local artist from Fergana.
sentences.translation: Bu portretni kim **chizgan**? — Farg'onalik mahalliy rassom.

sentences.text: Emma's car **was hit by** a lorry, but luckily she wasn't inside it.
sentences.translation: Emmaning mashinasiga yuk mashinasi **urilib ketdi**, lekin baxtiga u ichida emas edi.

sentences.text: Every payment over a thousand pounds **is checked by** two different managers.
sentences.translation: Ming funtdan ortiq har bir to'lovni ikki xil menejer **tekshiradi**.

examples.title: Questions: **When was** it **built**? **Is** it **included**?
examples.description: So'roqda be egadan oldin keladi, V3 joyida qoladi, do / did ishlatilmaydi. «Kim tomonidan?» savolida by oxirida.

sentences.text: When **was** the first metro line in Tashkent **opened**? — In 1977.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda birinchi metro liniyasi qachon **ochilgan**? — 1977-yilda.

sentences.text: **Are** visitors **allowed** to take photos inside the museum? — Only without flash.
sentences.translation: Muzey ichida suratga olishga **ruxsat beriladimi**? — Faqat chaqmoqsiz.

sentences.text: Where **were** these trainers **made**? — In Vietnam, according to the label.
sentences.translation: Bu krossovkalar qayerda **ishlab chiqarilgan**? — Yorlig'iga ko'ra, Vyetnamda.

sentences.text: **Was** anyone **hurt** in the accident on the ring road this morning?
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab halqa yo'ldagi avariyada kimdir **jarohatlandimi**?

sentences.text: How often **are** the windows in this building **cleaned**? — Twice a year.
sentences.translation: Bu binoning derazalari qanchalik tez-tez **tozalanadi**? — Yiliga ikki marta.

sentences.text: Who **was** this report **written by**? It's full of spelling mistakes.
sentences.translation: Bu hisobotni kim **yozgan**? Imlo xatolariga to'la-ku.

sentences.text: Why **was** the concert **postponed**? — The singer had lost her voice.
sentences.translation: Konsert nega **qoldirildi**? — Xonandaning ovozi chiqmay qolgan edi.

sentences.text: **Is** breakfast **included** in the price? — Yes, it**'s served** from seven till ten.
sentences.translation: Nonushta narxga **kiradimi**? — Ha, u yettidan o'ngacha **tortiladi**.

sentences.text: **Were** the exam results **announced** yesterday, or are we still waiting?
sentences.translation: Imtihon natijalari kecha **e'lon qilindimi** yoki hali ham kutyapmizmi?

sentences.text: Which languages **are taught** at Nilufar's new school? — English, Russian and Korean.
sentences.translation: Nilufarning yangi maktabida qaysi tillar **o'qitiladi**? — Ingliz, rus va koreys tillari.

examples.title: Negatives: **isn't allowed**, **wasn't invited**
examples.description: Inkorda not be dan keyin keladi: isn't / aren't / wasn't / weren't + V3. O'zbekchada — «-il-» + «-ma-»: qabul qili**n**maydi.

sentences.text: Smoking **isn't allowed** anywhere on the university campus.
sentences.translation: Universitet hududining hech bir joyida chekishga **ruxsat berilmaydi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **wasn't invited** to the wedding, and he still doesn't know why.
sentences.translation: Bekzod to'yga **taklif qilinmagan**, nega ekanini hali ham bilmaydi.

sentences.text: Credit cards **aren't accepted** at the bazaar, so bring some cash.
sentences.translation: Bozorda kredit kartalar **qabul qilinmaydi**, shuning uchun naqd pul olib keling.

sentences.text: Unfortunately, our complaint **wasn't taken** seriously by the hotel manager.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, mehmonxona menejeri shikoyatimizni jiddiy **qabul qilmadi**.

sentences.text: These shoes **weren't made** for mountain walks — just look at them now!
sentences.translation: Bu tuflilar tog'da yurish uchun **mo'ljallanmagan** — ahvoliga bir qarang!

sentences.text: Why **wasn't** I **told** that the meeting had moved to Thursday?
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish payshanbaga ko'chirilgani menga nega **aytilmadi**?

sentences.text: Tips **aren't** usually **expected** in Japanese restaurants, unlike in Britain.
sentences.translation: Britaniyadan farqli o'laroq, Yaponiya restoranlarida odatda choychaqa **kutilmaydi**.

sentences.text: Although the river looks clean, the water **isn't treated**, so don't drink it.
sentences.translation: Daryo toza ko'rinsa ham, suvi **tozalanmaydi**, shuning uchun uni ichmang.

sentences.text: Sarah's application **wasn't accepted** because one document was missing.
sentences.translation: Bitta hujjat yetishmagani uchun Saraning arizasi **qabul qilinmadi**.

sentences.text: In those days girls **weren't encouraged** to study science, but my grandmother became a doctor.
sentences.translation: O'sha paytlarda qizlarni aniq fanlarni o'qishga **undashmasdi**, lekin buvim shifokor bo'ldi.

examples.title: Active or passive? What is the sentence about?
examples.description: Gapning egasi — biz gapirayotgan narsa. Bir gapning o'zida faol va majhul nisbat: tanlov mavzuga qarab qilinadi.

sentences.text: My uncle built this house himself, and it **was finished** in just eight months.
sentences.translation: Bu uyni amakim o'zi qurgan, u bor-yo'g'i sakkiz oyda **qurib bitkazilgan**.

sentences.text: The police stopped the driver, and he **was taken** to the station for questioning.
sentences.translation: Politsiya haydovchini to'xtatdi va u so'roq uchun bo'limga **olib ketildi**.

sentences.text: This disease **is caused** by a virus that lives in dirty water.
sentences.translation: Bu kasallikni iflos suvda yashaydigan virus **keltirib chiqaradi**.

sentences.text: We didn't choose the hotel ourselves — it **was booked** by the company.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonani o'zimiz tanlamaganmiz — uni kompaniya **band qilgan**.

sentences.text: Jasur's phone rang during the exam, and he **was asked** to leave the room.
sentences.translation: Imtihon paytida Jasurning telefoni jiringladi va undan xonani tark etish **so'raldi**.

sentences.text: A famous chef opened the restaurant, but it **was closed** after only a year.
sentences.translation: Restoranni mashhur oshpaz ochgan edi, lekin u bor-yo'g'i bir yildan keyin **yopildi**.

sentences.text: Volunteers organise the festival, and it **is visited** by thousands of people every year.
sentences.translation: Festivalni ko'ngillilar tashkil qiladi va unga har yili minglab odam **tashrif buyuradi**.

sentences.text: Everybody knows Navoi's poems because they **are studied** in every school.
sentences.translation: Navoiy she'rlarini hamma biladi, chunki ular har bir maktabda **o'rganiladi**.

sentences.text: I didn't break the vase! It **was knocked over** by the cat.
sentences.translation: Guldonni men sindirmadim! Uni mushuk **ag'darib yubordi**.

sentences.text: Kate wrote an article about climate change, and it **was published** in The Guardian.
sentences.translation: Keyt iqlim o'zgarishi haqida maqola yozdi va u «The Guardian» gazetasida **chop etildi**.

examples.title: Mixed: news, science and everyday life
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: is / was + V3, by, inkor va so'roq — yangiliklar uslubidagi murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: According to the report, around 300 new schools **were opened** across the country last year.
sentences.translation: Hisobotga ko'ra, o'tgan yili mamlakat bo'ylab 300 ga yaqin yangi maktab **ochildi**.

sentences.text: A rare painting that **was stolen** in 1990 **was found** in a flat in Manchester last week.
sentences.translation: 1990-yilda **o'g'irlangan** noyob rasm o'tgan hafta Manchesterdagi bir kvartiradan **topildi**.

sentences.text: Dozens of villages near the river **were flooded** after three days of heavy rain.
sentences.translation: Uch kunlik kuchli yomg'irdan keyin daryo bo'yidagi o'nlab qishloqlarni **suv bosdi**.

sentences.text: Is it true that the new stadium **was paid for** by private investors?
sentences.translation: Yangi stadionning pulini xususiy investorlar **to'lagani** rostmi?

sentences.text: Every weekend hundreds of plastic bottles **are collected** from the beach by volunteers.
sentences.translation: Har dam olish kunida ko'ngillilar plyajdan yuzlab plastik butilkalarni **yig'ib olishadi**.

sentences.text: The winners of the competition **are chosen** by a jury of five teachers.
sentences.translation: Tanlov g'oliblarini besh o'qituvchidan iborat hakamlar hay'ati **tanlaydi**.

sentences.text: My sister's flight **was delayed**, so we waited at the airport for four hours.
sentences.translation: Opamning reysi **kechiktirildi**, shuning uchun aeroportda to'rt soat kutdik.

sentences.text: Why **are** so many good films **ignored** by the big film festivals?
sentences.translation: Nega shuncha yaxshi filmlar katta kinofestivallarda **e'tiborsiz qoladi**?

sentences.text: Nilufar applied for a scholarship at Oxford, and two months later she **was accepted**.
sentences.translation: Nilufar Oksforddagi stipendiyaga hujjat topshirdi va ikki oydan keyin **qabul qilindi**.

sentences.text: Although the bridge **was repaired** only last year, new cracks **were noticed** this spring.
sentences.translation: Ko'prik o'tgan yilgina **ta'mirlangan** bo'lsa-da, bu bahor unda yangi yoriqlar **ko'rindi**.
